siteSettings.title: English Adventures: A vs. An - Articles

modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Articles Lessons
modules.instructions: Master the use of indefinite articles A and AN, definite article THE, and when to use no article. Learn the rules for choosing between A and AN based on sound.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Writing Practice
modules.instructions: Write sentences using A, AN, and THE correctly. Practice with consonant and vowel sounds, and special cases.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Grammar Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice choosing the correct article in various contexts, including tricky words and exceptions.

modules.name: Quiz
modules.title: Quick Quiz
modules.instructions: Test your knowledge with multiple choice questions about articles. Choose the correct article to practice quickly!

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Articles Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply articles correctly in sentences. Master pronunciation-based rules, special cases, and zero article usage.
